answer: In the simple (unadjusted) logistic regression of camrelizumab treatment response on age, the coefficient for age is -0.0750 (SE = 0.0244, p = 0.0021), i.e., each 1-year increase in age is associated with a change of -0.0750 in the log-odds of treatment response (odds ratio ≈ 0.928 per year). The intercept (log-odds of response at age 0) is 4.4466.
